decriminalization.summary: Sodomy was dropped from the penal code in 1791 and sex between adults is not a specific offence. Public-indecency and age-of-consent rules apply to everyone.

marriage.summary: Civil marriage and joint adoption are open to same-sex couples under the 2013 "mariage pour tous" law.

genderRecognition.summary: Changing the sex marker on civil records goes through the tribunal judiciaire. Since 2016 no medical treatment, surgery or sterilisation can be required, but it is still a court procedure.

sources.label: Loi n° 2016-1547, art. 56 (civil code arts. 61-5 to 61-8, Légifrance)

conversionTherapy.summary: Practices aimed at changing or suppressing someone's sexual orientation or gender identity are a criminal offence (penal code art. 225-4-13), with higher penalties where the victim is a minor.

sources.label: Loi n° 2022-92 du 31 janvier 2022 (dossier législatif, Sénat)

asylum.summary: Claims based on sexual orientation or gender identity are assessed as membership of a particular social group. The EU qualification rules apply directly in France.

sources.label: OFPRA — orientation sexuelle et identité de genre
